news.title: July marks major milestones in UNI history
news.summary_en: As we celebrate the UNI Sesquicentennial, July brings several significant anniversaries in the university's history.

news.title: Fireworks Over the Dome caps off historic holiday weekend on July 5
news.summary_en: Originally scheduled for July 2, the event was moved because of inclement weather, creating a fitting grand finale to the extended holiday weekend.

news.title: UNI’s Family Business Center expands industry network with four leading Iowa firms
news.summary_en: Four Iowa firms have pledged their support to the University of Northern Iowa Family Business Center (FBC) for the 2026-27 program year.
